detail.longDescription: 🤖 Dell Container Storage Modules (CSM): 6 critical flaws, incl. CVE-2026-63688 and CVE-2026-63692 (CVSS 10.0). Missing authentication lets an unauthenticated attacker seize storage backend admin credentials and fully bypass the authz model. Hardcoded JWT keys too. Fixed in 1.18.0, no workaround. 🔗 https:// thehackernews.com/2026/10/dell -csm-flaws-enable-unauthenticated.html # CVE # CyberSec # Kubernetes
